notes: High priority: private VPC deployment. Must demonstrate in-transit + at-rest encryption and key rotation controls.
Encryption posture asked specifically: mTLS between client -> control plane, and between control plane -> worker nodes. They require TLS1.2+ with ciphers >= ECDHE_RSA_AESGCM.
At-rest: expect envelope encryption using customer-managed keys (BYOK) in cloud KMS or HSM. Customer prefers AWS KMS with external key material, but open to Azure Key Vault HSM or on-prem HSM.
Key rotation: requires automated rotation schedule (30-90 days configurable), rotation audit trail, and ability to rotate without downtime for cached KV entries — they want sample rotation runbook.
Secrets management: central Vault recommended (HashiCorp Vault or cloud secrets). They will not store plaintext keys in Redwood control plane; require sealed-wrapping and transient tokens for nodes.
Audit logging: push of all control-plane and API access logs to their SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). Retention policy: 7 years for audit logs for certain regulated lines of business.
Data residency: model inputs/outputs must remain in customer VPC and never be routed via hosted multi-tenant workers. Need signed attestation and diagram showing data paths.
Compliance asks: SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, penetration test report, FIPS-140-2 compatibility for crypto modules used in HSM path.
Performance constraints: low-latency requirement for fraud-reranking path — p99 < 80ms for 1K TPS burst; will validate on Dedicated GPU pool before final signoff.

Legal wants explicit language for key escrow, deletion on contract termination, and audit access for retained logs.
